1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, including at least one parameter selected from the group consisting of resolution of the picture, frequency of mode usage, and coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence, and wherein the updating is based on feedback from the actual parameters.
